about: What changed in each reworked deck, shown in the Card Library (Sprint 8, round two). The Studio Lead's words for the trial's seventh version (v0.7), each line checked against the trial cards and decks files. Each deck: a title, two lines of identity, a short list of changes; about 170 words a deck at most, plain words. Lines that begin "New:" changed since the page of 26 November.
heading: What changed
intro: The four decks have been reworked so each plays its own way, and no pairing has a handicap. Lines that begin "New:" changed since the page of 26 November. Pick a deck.

identity: The attacker. It closes fast and breaks the line: its armor readies after a kill, and a won fight drives the enemy back.
A prepared defense or a cut Supply line stops it. BREAKTHROUGH is its tool against the first, RED BALL against the second.
changes: New: one RED BALL starts in the Initial Entry. BREAKTHROUGH is Generation III, so it is back in the Main Force (2 copies): an Initial Entry holds Generation I only.
BREAKTHROUGH ignores RIPOSTE as well as OBSTACLE for the round.
ROUGH RIDER scouts: ZONE RECONNAISSANCE (reveal 1 Hidden enemy card, gain 2 ISR) replaces CROSS-CUE.
WARLORD's HUNTER-KILLER readies when it destroys an enemy Frontline card, once per round.
LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1. Its SITREP readies a card that has a SUPPORT line.
REAVERS cost 2. FLYSWATTER moves to the Main Force.
REDLEG's FIRE SUPPORT now prints what the game plays: it adds to an attack at any range.
New: no balance provision. Every Skirmish starts level.

identity: The defender. A Close attack on its line costs the attacker, and COUNTERATTACK hits back in Contact.
It wins late, on points, by outlasting the attack on its own line. It has no quick win of its own.
changes: New: the Initial Entry is Generation I only. BACKTRACK and one STEEL RAIN start there; DRUMFIRE and SUNLANCE wait in the Main Force.
New card BACKTRACK: cannon artillery with a counterfire radar. FIRE SUPPORT 2, and COUNTERFIRE answers an enemy Fires attack.
New: TRENCHER prints two lines, DIG IN and RIPOSTE 1. Its COVER 1 is gone.
RIPOSTE 1 on TRENCHER and REDOUBT: a unit that makes a Close attack on your Frontline takes 1 damage. Only your highest RIPOSTE counts.
COUNTERATTACK costs 1 and needs only Contact. New: 2 copies, not 3.
WATCHTOWER, an observation post: SCAN gains 2 ISR. New: 1 copy.
REDOUBT's COVER is 1. BREAKWATER costs 8; its RIPOSTE action is renamed BREAK THE ASSAULT.
DEFENSIVE CYBERSPACE OPERATIONS is now DCO. LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1.
In: FENCE, a second CITADEL. Out: FLYSWATTER, DEFENSE IN DEPTH, one MYRMIDON, one REDLEG, one DCO.
New: no balance provision. Every Skirmish starts level.

identity: The information deck. It takes the ISR lead and makes the enemy pay for trailing: lost Homefront, exhausted cards, canceled attacks.
It destroys little and takes little ground. It wins on points, through the ISR lead.
changes: New: AUGUR's SPOOF costs no ISR again, as released. One AUGUR starts in the Initial Entry; the second waits in the Main Force.
New: a WATCHTOWER starts in the Initial Entry (SCAN gains 2 ISR). GRAY ZONE is out.
New: WIRETAP prints two lines, COMPROMISE 3 and ADVANTAGE (draw a card each Sustainment while you have more ISR). Its JAM 1 is gone.
INFORMATION ADVANTAGE, 2 copies: for three rounds, while you have more ISR, the enemy loses 1 Homefront at Assessment.
BUSHWHACKER, irregular fighters, 2 copies: HOLD 2 and a Close AMBUSH.
ELECTRONIC ATTACK is carried twice. THE SILENT costs 6.
NAVIGATION WARFARE is now DEAD RECKONING.
POLTERGEIST's INJECT may bring a card to H-Hour. TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL may also be played as a Reaction.
Out: STRATEGIC NARRATIVE, SYSTEMS CASCADE, WAR WEARINESS, VELITES, one PUPPETEER.
New: no balance provision. Every Skirmish starts level.

identity: The fires deck. It finds, strikes from range, confirms, and strikes again before the enemy can close.
It cannot hold ground: an enemy that reaches its line and stays there beats it.
changes: New: one STEEL RAIN starts in the Initial Entry beside two JAEGER (it was two STEEL RAIN and one JAEGER). A second VELITES replaces one BLACK SAIL.
TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL joins the deck in place of CONVERGENCE. It may also be played as a Reaction when your Frontline is attacked in Contact.
BLACK FALCON's HYPERSONIC is ATK 5, down from 6.
FIRE SUPPORT on REDLEG and DRUMFIRE now prints what the game plays: it adds to an attack at any range.
LONGKNIFE HQ costs 1. Its SITREP readies a card that has a SUPPORT line.
